extDescription.message: Hides online-gambling (judol) spam on YouTube and social media, and blocks gambling sites. Runs on your device.

popupUnsupported.message: This page isn't scanned. Anti-Judol works on YouTube, and on X, Reddit, Twitch, Disqus, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok when you enable them in Settings → Platforms.

popupResetPage.message: Use default settings for this page

reportCopied.message: Report copied. Paste it into the aduankonten.id form, then submit.

reportCopyFailed.message: Copy this page's address into the aduankonten.id form.

optAction.message: What to do with gambling content

optPreblur.message: Soft-blur while Jev is still checking

optPlatformsHelp.message: YouTube is on by default. Other platforms need access to that site: Chrome asks when you tick one, and you can revoke it any time.

optPlatformDisqusNote.message: comment sections on news sites and blogs

optWebScan.message: Hide gambling ads, banners and links on all sites

optWebScanHelp.message: Needs the "read and change data on all sites" permission. Checking is 100% local: page content is never sent anywhere, not even to the AI. It also shows a warning page (instead of an error screen) for gambling sites, and warns you about sites hacked to promote gambling.

optBlockRemote.message: Use the community list (HaGeZi Gambling, updated every 12 hours)

optBlockHelp.message: The list is downloaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net. Nothing about you is sent; blocking is done by the browser itself, so the extension never sees which sites you open.

optBlockDomains.message: Extra domains to block (one per line)

optCustomHelp.message: Matched after disguises are undone, so "gacor88" also catches "g4c0r 88" and "𝐆𝐀𝐂𝐎𝐑𝟖𝟖".

optCustomBlock.message: Always treat as gambling (one per line)

optCustomBlockPh.message: gambling site names you keep seeing

optCustomAllowPh.message: channel names or game terms you like

optAiHelp.message: Without this, the extension still works 100% on your device with the built-in filter and sends nothing.

optAiNotice.message: the text of visible comments, titles and chat messages on supported platforms, plus the sender's name, only to api.typesafe.ai (and openrouter.ai if you set a fallback key), solely to decide whether it is gambling promotion. No URLs, history, cookies or account data are sent.

optConsent.message: I agree that visible text is sent to the classification API above

optOrKey.message: OpenRouter API key — optional fallback, paid (about $$0.042 per 1M input tokens)

optKeyHelp.message: Keys are stored only on this device, can't be read by web pages or content scripts, and are never shown again. Leave the field empty to keep the saved key.

optDailyLimit.message: Max comments sent per day (0 = unlimited)

optSync.message: Sync settings and whitelist through your Chrome account

optSyncHelp.message: Uses your own Chrome Sync. API keys are never synced or exported.

optImportInvalid.message: Not a valid Anti-Judol export file

optImported.message: Settings imported ✓ (API keys stay on this device)

badgeHint.message: $1 · click the content to view it

btnAllowAria.message: Mark as not gambling and never hide it again

pageWarnBody.message: $1 has probably been hacked and filled with gambling ads. Don't enter personal data or make any transfers.

blockedHeading.message: This site was blocked because it looks like online gambling

blockedExplain.message: Anti-Judol Shield stopped this page before it loaded. Nothing from this site was opened.
